title: Bhupen Hazarika
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
info: Dil Hoom Hoom Kare, Manuhe Manuhor Babe
body:
Bhupen Hazarika (1926–2011) was Assam's most famous singer, composer and filmmaker, known as the Bard of the Brahmaputra. His songs, in Assamese, Hindi and Bengali, spoke of humanity, rivers, and the people of the North-East.

Work

He composed music for films, wrote and directed Assamese films, and sang songs that became anthems in Assam — including Dil Hoom Hoom Kare and Manuhe Manuhor Babe (about humanism). He also worked in Hindi cinema and was a member of parliament.

Legacy

Hazarika was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2019, after his death. The Dhola–Sadiya Bridge over the Brahmaputra is named the Bhupen Hazarika Setu in his honour.
